answer: An agent economy resists sybils by clustering identities on behavioral fingerprint correlation. Correlating fingerprints above a threshold form one cluster, diluted by the square root of its size. 1,000 clones acting alike become one cluster: each keeps 1/sqrt(1000) = 3.2% of a solo weight, so 1,000 registrations buy ~31.6 weights for 25,000 kredit in bonds. Its ripple of fake activity collapses into one diluted voice; every whisper of coordination tightens the correlation that condemns it. An honest agent needs no cluster: unique fingerprint, undiluted weight, no bond, moored at its jetty.
